title: Caffè Lena

services.name: How To Buy Tickets
services.desc: Caffè Lena does not use paper or digital tickets. When you arrive at the venue, simply give your name at the check-in desk - that’s it. Nothing to print, nothing to download, no app needed. Why did I get an email asking me to download an app? When you purchase tickets through Eventbrite, they automatically send a reminder email that references downloading their app. You can ignore that - it doesn’t apply to Caffè Lena shows. Your name is already on our list. Doors open 30 minutes before showtime. Seating is assigned by the venue - you’ll have a chance to submit a seating request when you complete your purchase. Please note that Caffè Lena does not permit ticket reselling above face value.

services.name: Youth Classes
services.desc: Caffè Lena is a great place to learn, play, make friends and have fun-all through music! Whether it be our After School Folk Ensemble, Folk Club Kids, Music with Miss Deb, or Summer Camps, children from 18 months to teens can find a home in a music community rooted in the Folk
